name: Shiromiko
source:
Kouta was an unattractive soccer club member. After his classmate and childhood friend Youko was suddenly hospitalized, he learned from his mother Fumiko that their family holds a secret power that can cure any disease.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
孝太是一个不起眼的足球部成员。在同学兼青梅竹马阳子突然住院后，他从母亲文子那里得知，他们的家族拥有一种能治愈任何疾病的秘密力量。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
